Research snippets report brain-scan evidence that dogs can detect speech, distinguish languages, and process both “what we say” and “how we say it” [d2][d3][d8].

At the same time, the evidence here does not support full human-like language understanding: some snippets say dogs understand words only “to a certain extent” or rely heavily on tone and body language [d1][d6].
